backend/main.mo: Defines subject and module types, stores first-year subjects, and exposes query methods to fetch subjects and modules.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, affected files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing various frontend files including models, DB logic, utilities, components, and pages.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and base styling for the app.
frontend/index.html: Static HTML entry point loading the React app and metadata for PWA behavior.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, theme colors, icons, and startup behavior.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Wraps the router with a database initialization gate for safe app startup.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Main layout applying dark mode and rendering routed pages with bottom navigation.
frontend/src/components/attendance/Class: Card UI for a single class log showing status, time, and buttons to mark present or absent.
frontend/src/components/attendance/Conse: Renders grouped consecutive timetable periods with expandable individual class cards and attendance actions.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Bottom navigation bar with six route buttons and active state highlighting.
frontend/src/components/DbInitGate.tsx: Gate component handling IndexedDB initialization with timeout, error UI, and reload options.
frontend/src/components/MonthlySummaryCa: Displays monthly attendance counts and percentage based on per-class logs.
frontend/src/components/NextClassCard.ts: Computes and shows the next upcoming class from timetable entries.
frontend/src/components/RecordDetailShee: Modal sheet for viewing and editing class log details, including topic and attendance status. Supports updating and deleting records.
frontend/src/components/SubjectStatsCard: Displays per-subject theory and practical attendance stats with status colors and deficit/safe-miss calculations.
frontend/src/components/timetable/Timeta: Dialog for creating or editing timetable entries with fields for day, time, subject, type, and repeat flag.
Renders a weekly timetable grouped by day with edit and delete actions for each entry.
frontend/src/components/TodaySchedule.ts: Shows today's timetable entries, links them with logs, groups consecutive classes, and allows marking attendance.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceRules.ts: Defines attendance thresholds and functions to compute per‑subject and overall attendance statistics.
frontend/src/domain/eligibilityMath.ts: Provides formulas to calculate required classes to meet thresholds and allowable absences.
frontend/src/domain/groupConsecutiveTime: Groups consecutive timetable entries with matching subject and type into combined blocks.
frontend/src/domain/statusColor.ts: Maps attendance percentages to color-coded status and labels.
frontend/src/domain/subjects.ts: Defines MBBS subjects, their types, and maps class types to attendance categories.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an authentication context using Internet Identity with login, logout, and identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalStore.ts: Provides reactive hooks for class logs, timetable entries, and settings with local storage syncing.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base theme defining light and dark medical-themed color variables and utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/AddClassPage.tsx: Page for creating single or multiple class logs with attendance status and saving them to local storage.
frontend/src/pages/AnalyticsPage.tsx: Computes subject-wise stats and monthly attendance trends, displaying comparison and trend charts.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Shows subject attendance overview, today's schedule, next class, and a monthly summary using logs and timetable entries.
frontend/src/pages/RecordsPage.tsx: Displays class logs with filtering, searching, and editing capabilities via a detail sheet.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Provides appearance and attendance settings plus CSV and PDF export options for logs and stats.
frontend/src/pages/TimetablePage.tsx: Manages timetable entries with add, edit, and delete actions using a weekly grid and dialog.
frontend/src/router.tsx: Defines application routes and links pages into the TanStack router tree.
frontend/src/storage/db.ts: IndexedDB wrapper that initializes the database, creates object stores, handles blocked/upgrade events, and performs migration from legacy attendance logs to per-class records.
frontend/src/storage/models.ts: Defines TypeScript models for class logs, timetable entries, settings, and attendance stats with fields used for offline storage.
frontend/src/utils/exportCsv.ts: Exports class log records to a CSV file by generating rows and triggering a downloadable blob link.
frontend/src/utils/exportPdf.ts: Generates a print-ready HTML document summarizing attendance stats and opens it in a new window for PDF export.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending themes, colors, animations, and enabling plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Tracks project state, known issues, and feature requests, notably identifying an IndexedDB initialization hang and UI refinement needs.
